subject: english
prompt:
A museum keeps its paper maps in a dim room. Visitors may view one map at a time, but they must return it before taking another. The guide explains that bright light can fade the ink, so the maps are shown only briefly.

Why are the maps shown only briefly?

options.text: Bright light can make the ink fade.
Visitors are not allowed to read maps.
The museum has no paper maps.
The guide wants visitors to draw on the maps.

answer.explanation: because 引出的原因是強光會使墨色褪去，所以展示時間受到限制。 正確答案：A。
